text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Banco Comercial Portugues (BCP) and retail group Jeronimo Martins are to launch a new bank using the licence of Banco Comercial de Macau (BCM Portugal). This financial institution may open before retailer Sonae launches its new bank Universo Banco Directo.
- Portugal's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) continued to fall in the second quarter of 1996, says a report from the Economy Ministry made available to the newspaper.
- Privatisation of chemicals company Quimigal has been postponed to the beginning of 1997, the newspaper learns from an official source of the Economy Ministry.
- Private mobile telephone company Telecel plans to launch a new service from September 9 allowing clients to conduct banking operations by telephone.

- Jeronimo Martins clients will be able to buy financial products in around 100 supermarkets and hypermarkets when the retail company joins banking group Banco Comercial Portugues in establishing a new bank.
- Jeronimo Martins and BCP will launch their new retail bank with a capital of four billion escudos.

- Strong growth in the cement market in the last few months is good news for cement company Semapa/Secil which expects to double its consolidated turnover to around 60 billion escudos by the end of the year.
